india.headline: Innefu claims AI flagged suspected ₹5,700 crore GST exposure; verification pending
india.source_title: AI platform detects alleged ₹5,700 crore GST fraud network involving 1,500 shell companies in India
india.summary: Innefu Labs says its Prophecy Eagle I system identified suspected input-tax-credit fraud involving more than 1,500 businesses and estimated exposure of ₹5,700 crore. Mint reports that enforcement authorities have yet to verify the findings, so the amount is neither confirmed fraud nor recovered revenue.

india.headline: NeuroDX reports early Sphota model results awaiting independent evaluation
india.source_title: India’s Frontier AI Race Gets a 240M Model That Beats Liquid AI
india.summary: Indian startup NeuroDX says its 240-million-parameter Sphota language model achieved comparable benchmark performance to a Liquid AI model with less training data. AIM's interview makes clear that these are preliminary company results, without independent public evaluation, and that the gains may change as the model scales.
